title: Pure Labrynth
summary: Pure Labrynth control build with generic Normal Traps, Fiend Extra Deck bosses, and staples. Welcome Labrynth and Big Welcome Labrynth summon Labrynth monsters from the Deck, and every time a Normal Trap removes a monster from the field, your Labrynth monsters, furniture, and traps trigger to draw cards, destroy cards, and reset themselves.

summary.title: Starters
points: Arianna the Labrynth Servant searches any Labrynth card from the Deck on summon and draws a card (or Special Summons a Fiend or Sets a Spell/Trap) when a Normal Trap removes a monster.
Ariane the Labrynth Servant sends a Normal Trap from your hand or Set on your field to the GY to Special Summon a Level 4 or lower Fiend from the Deck.
Labrynth Stovie Torbie and Labrynth Chandraglier (the furniture) discard themselves and another card as a Quick Effect on either turn to Set a Labrynth Spell or Trap directly from the Deck.

Arias the Labrynth Butler sends itself from the hand or field to the GY on either Main Phase to Special Summon a Labrynth monster or Set a Normal Trap from your hand that can be activated the same turn.

summary.title: Opening: Arianna + Labrynth Cooclock or Stovie Torbie
steps: Normal Summon Arianna the Labrynth Servant to search Labrynth Cooclock (or Big Welcome Labrynth if you already hold Cooclock).

Activate Labrynth Cooclock's hand effect to discard itself, then pitch Stovie Torbie and another card to Set Big Welcome Labrynth from the Deck; because Cooclock resolved, Big Welcome Labrynth is live this turn.

Activate Big Welcome Labrynth to Special Summon Lovely Labrynth of the Silver Castle from the Deck and bounce Arianna back to your hand, triggering Cooclock and Stovie Torbie to return from the GY and Lovely Labrynth to pop a card in the opponent's hand or field.

summary.title: Furniture Loops & Trap Recursion
summary.text: Every time a monster leaves the field by your Normal Trap effect (including Big Welcome Labrynth bouncing your own monster or Compulsory Evacuation Device bouncing theirs), Stovie Torbie Special Summons itself from the GY, Chandraglier returns to the hand, and Welcome Labrynth Sets itself back from the GY. Lovely Labrynth prevents the opponent from responding to your Normal Trap activations with monster effects and resets any Normal Trap from your GY each turn.

summary.title: Control & Fiend Extra Deck
points: Lady Labrynth of the Silver Castle Special Summons itself from the hand as a Quick Effect when a Labrynth card or Normal Trap is activated, cannot be targeted or destroyed while you control a Set card, and chains to any Normal Trap to Set a different Normal Trap directly from the Deck.
Single-copy silver-bullet Normal Traps—Destructive Daruma Karma Cannon, Compulsory Evacuation Device, Torrential Tribute, Trap Trick, and Transaction Rollback—are tutored on demand by Lady Labrynth.

Welcome Labrynth locks your Deck and Extra Deck summons to Fiends until the end of the next turn after it resolves, which A Bao A Qu, the Lightless Shadow, Luce the Dusk's Dark, Beat Cop from the Underworld, and Dispatchparazzi all satisfy.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Labrynth Labyrinth adds a non-targeting pop to every Welcome Normal Trap you activate and revives a Fiend when a non-Labrynth Normal Trap resolves.
Big Welcome Labrynth banishes itself from the GY to bounce a Fiend you control (or any card the opponent controls while you control a Level 8+ Fiend).
Labrynth Set-Up shuffles two GY/banished Labrynth Spells/Traps into the Deck to Set two non-Labrynth Normal Traps from the Deck.
